featured_reviews.name: prachi jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm writing this review to express my concern about the steadily declining maintenance standards at this gym. Given the current condition of the facilities, I strongly feel that the monthly membership fee of ₹11,000 should be reduced to ₹10,000.

There are several persistent issues that have been left unaddressed:

No personal locker facility is available.

Tissue papers are often missing in the washrooms.

Cleanliness is below acceptable standards, with cockroaches frequently spotted on the floor.

These issues reflect poorly on the quality of service, especially considering the premium fees being charged.

Additionally, on May 7th, I visited to renew my membership and requested if my membership could be paused for June, as I’ll be traveling. The receptionist contacted the owner but couldn't reach him. I was told I couldn’t begin workouts until a decision was made. Despite clearly stating that I was still willing to renew, I was denied access. The trainer, Sahil, and the receptionist were extremely rude and made me wait unnecessarily.

As a long-standing member, this kind of treatment was very disappointing and showed a complete lack of customer support and respect. I considered not returning, but out of habit, I did only to realize that the attitude and service were simply not worth it.

Thankfully, I’ve now joined Gymathon in Mazgaon. They offered a 1.5-month free trial without any hassle and activated my membership exactly as requested, starting at the end of June. They also provide personal lockers and a steamer facility all at the same ₹11,000.

So, in hindsight, I’m grateful for the poor experience here it led me to a far better one elsewhere.

featured_reviews.name: Usama Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve trained at different places over the years, but Incline Fitness genuinely stands out.

Hands down the best gym in Mazgaon, and honestly, it would hold its own anywhere outside it too. The equipment is top quality, well maintained, and there’s enough variety that you can train seriously without waiting around for machines. The atmosphere is focused and disciplined without feeling intimidating. People come here to work.

A special mention to Sohail Sir, my personal trainer. The man knows his craft. He pushes you exactly as much as you need, keeps your form tight, and actually tracks your progress instead of just counting reps. Training with him feels structured, purposeful, and results driven.

Clean space. Strong energy. Zero nonsense.

Exactly what a proper gym should be.

featured_reviews.name: ankit jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve genuinely been enjoying my time at Incline Fitness. The gym has a great vibe, well-maintained equipment, and enough space to train comfortably even during peak hours. The staff is friendly, supportive, and always ready to help out with form or guidance.
Overall, a solid place to work out and stay consistent. Happy with my experience here!

featured_reviews.name: saher shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent gym with great facilities! The equipment is modern, well-maintained, and covers everything from strength training to cardio, so you don’t feel limited in your workout routine. The layout is well-planned, making it comfortable even when the gym is a bit busy.

The overall atmosphere is very motivating and energetic. Trainers are highly professional, friendly, and always ready to guide you — whether it’s correcting your form, suggesting workout plans, or giving fitness advice. They give personal attention without being pushy, which is a big plus.

Cleanliness and hygiene are top-notch. The workout areas, machines, and changing rooms are regularly cleaned and maintained, which makes the environment safe and pleasant. The gym is also well-managed during peak hours, so things remain organized.

Another great aspect is the positive crowd — people are focused and serious about fitness, which automatically keeps you motivated. The music and vibe also add to the overall workout experience.

Facilities like locker space, ventilation, lighting, and overall maintenance are properly taken care of. You can clearly see that the management focuses on quality and member satisfaction.

Really happy with the experience so far — it feels like a complete fitness setup rather than just a gym. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable and quality fitness center in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: BADRUL JAMALI UDAIPURWALA
featured_reviews.review_text: Incline Gym offers a clean, well-maintained environment with a focused and energetic atmosphere. The surroundings are organised and comfortable, with good ventilation and lighting. The coaches are experienced and pay attention to proper form, helping members train effectively. The gym is equipped with quality machines, free weights, and all essential equipment. Overall, it's a solid place for serious and consistent training.

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Salvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best and finest gym in the entire south Mumbai.
To be noticed more hygienic, smooth equipment and well knowledge trainers with detained knowledge of training & supplements as well.

Highly recommended 💪

featured_reviews.name: Abdul Maajid Nevrekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Great gym. Everything you need is available and the atmosphere is positive. No show-off crowd, just people focused on training. Definitely recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Samiksha Dhamane
featured_reviews.review_text: Truly impressed with the overall experience. Everything feels premium — from the equipment to the cleanliness and the supportive trainers. You can tell a lot of thought has gone into maintaining quality. Definitely one of the best gym in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: Aliasgar Kachwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been a member at  incline for the past 6 months, and it's hands down one of the best decisions I've made for my fitness journey! The gym is always spotlessly clean, with state-of-the-art equipment that's well-maintained and never overcrowded. The trainers are incredibly knowledgeable, supportive, and motivating—they take the time to understand your goals and push you just the right amount without overwhelming you.
The group classes are energetic and varied (love the HIIT and strength sessions!), and the overall vibe is welcoming and community-oriented—everyone from beginners to pros feels at home. I've seen real results in my strength, energy levels, and confidence since joining. Highly recommend incline to anyone in mazgaon looking for a top-notch gym experience. Worth every penny! 💪🏋️‍♂️

featured_reviews.name: Darshil Julasana
featured_reviews.review_text: I am going to vigour sphere since 6-7 months now. Initially i used to get dreaded since it’s a cross fit gym. But never knew my body is capable of performing such exercise routine that too after my working hours. All thanks to my trainers who makes sure you progress and all your forms are correct. They constantly check on you in between sets the same. All the 3 current trainers in the evening are best to work with and that’s what motivates you to go there after your heavy shifts. Thank you vigour sphere team. Keep the good work up.

featured_reviews.name: Prafull Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining The Vigour Sphere CrossFit Gym has been one of the best fitness decisions for me. The gym has a very energetic and motivating atmosphere, with excellent equipment and a positive vibe for both beginners and experienced fitness enthusiasts.

Special thanks to the trainers Amar, Pratik, and Durgesh — they are extremely supportive, knowledgeable, and always push you to achieve better results. Every session includes new workout formats, different exercises, strength training, and cardio combinations, which keeps the workouts exciting and never boring.

One of the best things is their guidance on fitness and nutrition, including whey protein combos and proper workout planning according to individual goals. The trainers focus on posture, technique, and personal attention, making workouts safe and effective.

The environment is friendly, disciplined, and highly motivating. If anyone is looking for a CrossFit gym in Lalbaug with professional trainers and result-oriented workouts, The Vigour Sphere is definitely worth joining. Highly recommended! 💪🔥

featured_reviews.name: Purandareshwar Kedar
featured_reviews.review_text: Amar sir & Pratik sir is best duo of trainers.... Motivates and gets the sets done from team.... AC, lights and cleaning is good.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started as a complete beginner, and I can already see a huge difference in my strength and confidence. The trainers are truly professional, and a new exercise chart is put up every day which keeps the workouts fresh and structured.

A big shoutout to "KEDAR Sir" — always on time, extremely dedicated, and guides perfectly. His motivation and discipline really push you to do better.

The gym is clean, positive, and honestly very reasonably priced compared to others. If you want genuine guidance and real results, this is the perfect place!

❤️
